comparison.objective: Seat a strain-wave flexspline unit into a robot-joint housing with its teeth meshed.
comparison.physical_skill: Align two axes, rotate to tooth phase while applying insertion force, avoid cocking, and release after seating.
comparison.success_condition: The collar is within 0.5 mm of the housing face, teeth are meshed, alignment tolerances hold, and the unit remains still after release.
comparison.reason: This robot-assembly task tests turn-to-mesh precision insertion, not two-tool threaded adjustment, countertorque locking, or repeated motion retention.
